This '''pin-up of a Hutt''' was seen on the wall of a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Addressed to an individual named [[Gary/Legends|Gary]], the image depicted a voluptuous [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who was looking over her shoulder while she smiled. The Hutt wore makeup, was dressed in a purple bodysuit, and had four [[Heart/Legends|heart]] [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] on her left shoulder. The [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] inscription on the upper-right corner of the image read "''To Gary X0X0''."<ref name="LT">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown|date=2010-04-30}}</ref>

A similar image of this Hutt was also found on the walls of a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] cell in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]], also located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Moshi_Bar.jpg|thumb|right|210px|Concept art of Tiggs Leo's tavern.]]
This image was one of several pin-up images seen on the walls of the cantina in the episode ''[[Lethal Trackdown]]''.<ref name="Lethal">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> During pre-production, a neon image of this pin-up was part of the facade of the cantina, as seen in concept art on the Blu-ray version of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]]</ref>

The poster can also be seen in a prison cell in the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center in "[[Deception]]."<ref name="Deception" />
